email_body:
Dear Embrace the Earth team,

I am writing to apply for the Environmental Marketing Officer role. Your mission to build a world where nature and society thrive together resonates deeply, and I would like to contribute my digital marketing and technical skills to help grow your revenue streams and impact.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing work, I build and optimize websites for search and AI visibility, write SEO content, and use analytics to measure results. I have experience with WordPress, Shopify, Google Analytics, and Semrush, and I enjoy designing value propositions that connect with audiences. I am fluent in English and have working knowledge of Dutch, and I am based in Belgium, which helps me understand the local ecosystem.

I am motivated by the opportunity to design and lead new initiatives from scratch and to support an emerging NGO. I am available to commit to the volunteer schedule and would welcome the chance to discuss how I can help Embrace the Earth grow.

Thank you for your consideration.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Embrace the Earth team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Environmental Marketing Officer position. Your mission to build a world where nature and society thrive together resonates deeply with me, and I would like to contribute my digital marketing and technical skills to help grow your revenue streams and impact.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing work, I build and optimize websites for search and AI visibility, write SEO content, and use analytics to measure results. I have experience with WordPress, Shopify, Google Analytics, and Semrush, and I enjoy designing value propositions that connect with audiences. For example, I built and optimized a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running technical SEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. I also handle on-page SEO and content for client websites, tracking performance with tools like Semrush and Google Analytics.

I am fluent in English and have working knowledge of Dutch, and I am based in Belgium, which helps me understand the local ecosystem. I am motivated by the opportunity to design and lead new initiatives from scratch and to support an emerging NGO. While my background is in digital marketing rather than environmental business development, I am eager to apply my skills to sustainable revenue models and impact communication.

I am available to commit to the volunteer schedule and would welcome the chance to discuss how I can help Embrace the Earth grow. Thank you for your consideration.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
